components.css: .ds-dial { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; padding: 0.9rem 0.6rem 0.7rem; background: repeating-linear-gradient(100deg, rgba(255,255,255,.035) 0px, rgba(255,255,255,.035) 1px, rgba(0,0,0,.05) 1px, rgba(0,0,0,.05) 2px), linear-gradient(180deg, #3d4149, #2a2d33); border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.06), 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.5); } .ds-dial-ring { width: 100%; max-width: 110px; aspect-ratio: 1; transform: rotate(-90deg); filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(242,167,27,.35)); } .ds-dial-track { fill: #101214; stroke: rgba(255,255,255,.06); stroke-width: 7; } .ds-dial-fill { fill: none; stroke: #f2a71b; stroke-width: 7; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-dasharray: 264; stroke-dashoffset: 187; transition: stroke-dashoffset .5s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); } .ds-dial-readout { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -46%); display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; line-height: 1.05; } .ds-dial-value { font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 600; color: #e8e6df; } .ds-dial-of { font-size: .72rem; color: #aeb2b9; } .ds-dial-pct { font-size: .72rem; color: #f2a71b; margin-top: .1rem; } .ds-dial-label { font-size: .72rem; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #aeb2b9; }

components.name: Toggle Switch (Add to Meal)
components.description: A recent/frequent food row with a toggle-switch control that stages it into the pending meal cart. Persistent state, not a fire-and-revert pulse — see The Honest State Rule.
components.css: .ds-toggle-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .75rem; width: 100%; padding: .6rem .7rem; background: #15171a; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05); border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; } .ds-toggle-row--in-cart { border-color: #7a5713; } .ds-toggle-switch { flex: none; width: 34px; height: 18px; border-radius: 9px; background: #101214; border: 1px solid #4a4e57; position: relative; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.6); } .ds-toggle-lever { position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px; width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; background: #aeb2b9; transition: transform .2s ease, background .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease; } .ds-toggle-row--in-cart .ds-toggle-lever { transform: translateX(16px); background: #f2a71b; box-shadow: 0 0 6px #f2a71b; } .ds-toggle-name { font-size: .9rem; color: #e8e6df; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-toggle-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: .72rem; color: #aeb2b9; } .ds-badge { padding: .1rem .4rem; border-radius: 4px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .04em; font-size: .7rem; border: 1px solid currentColor; } .ds-badge-estimated { color: #f2a71b; } .ds-badge-verified { color: #4ec9a0; } .ds-toggle-mark { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: .72rem; text-transform: uppercase; color: #f2a71b; }

components.name: Meal Cart Tray
components.description: Sticky bottom staging area for the meal being built — meal-type chips, staged items, the one control that actually writes to the server.
components.html: • Almonds · 30g
components.css: .ds-cart { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .55rem; background: repeating-linear-gradient(100deg, rgba(255,255,255,.035) 0px, rgba(255,255,255,.035) 1px, rgba(0,0,0,.05) 1px, rgba(0,0,0,.05) 2px), linear-gradient(180deg, #3d4149, #2a2d33); border: 1px solid #4a4e57; border-radius: 12px; padding: .7rem; box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.55); } .ds-cart-chips { display: flex; gap: .4rem; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-chip { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: .72rem; text-transform: uppercase; padding: .3rem .6rem; border-radius: 20px; border: 1px solid #4a4e57; background: #101214; color: #aeb2b9; } .ds-chip--active { border-color: #f2a71b; color: #f2a71b; } .ds-cart-commit { width: 100%; padding: .7rem; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #f2a71b; background: #f2a71b; color: #15171a; font-weight: 600; font-size: .85rem; }

components.name: Toast / Undo
components.description: The system's one recovery mechanism: appears after every commit and every delete, per The No Silent Write Rule.
components.css: .ds-toast { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .7rem; background: #3d4149; border: 1px solid #4a4e57; border-radius: 10px; padding: .65rem .7rem; box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.5); } .ds-toast-msg { flex: 1; font-size: .82rem; color: #e8e6df; } .ds-toast-action { color: #f2a71b; font-weight: 600; font-size: .8rem; background: none; border: none; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The confirming action in the settings sheet, and the sheet's 'Add to meal' / 'Save' action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { padding: .55rem 1.1rem; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #f2a71b; background: #f2a71b; color: #15171a; font-weight: 600; font-size: .85rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f2a71b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: The Catalog search field, pinned above the quick-add rack.
components.css: .ds-search-input { width: 100%; background: #101214; border: 1px solid #3d4149; border-radius: 8px; padding: .65rem .8rem; color: #e8e6df; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: .85rem; } .ds-search-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f2a71b; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Logging food should feel like scanning your own gauges before a flight, not filling out another diet app's form. The system is a cockpit instrument panel: a near-black brushed-metal chassis holding backlit dial-ring gauges, toggle-switch controls, and monospace digital readouts. Density is low and calm — four gauges, a search field, a rack of switches — because the panel is read multiple times a day at a glance, not browsed.

This is a phone-first Operate surface. Desktop renders the same panel centered in a fixed-width column rather than spreading into a wider dashboard layout.

Nothing writes to the server on a bare tap: food is staged into a pending meal (the cart tray) and only an explicit 'Log meal' commits, and every commit or delete surfaces an undo toast. This was added after /impeccable critique (2026-08-31) found the prior single-tap Quick Log wrote immediately with no confirmation and no undo, which caused a real accidental log.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black chassis with brushed-metal bezels (a fine repeating diagonal hatch, never a flat gradient standing in for the material)
Amber backlit glow as the one active accent; green/red-orange reserved for on/over target state
Every numeral in IBM Plex Mono; every label and heading in IBM Plex Sans, ≥0.7rem
Toggle switches (meal membership), dial rings (progress), the cart tray, and meal headers as the signature vocabulary
Icons are drawn (inline SVG, single stroke weight), never Unicode glyphs or emoji
Every write is staged then confirmed, and every commit/delete gets an undo toast

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Amber is the only color used for emphasis or action. Green and red-orange are status colors tied strictly to macro target state — they never appear as decoration or a second brand accent.

rules.name: The Measurement-Only Mono Rule
rules.body: Monospace is reserved for numbers and the labels directly attached to them. Entry and food names always render in the sans body face.

rules.name: The One Glow Rule
rules.body: The amber/red drop-shadow glow is reserved for the dial gauges' backlight. No other element glows.

rules.name: The Honest State Rule
rules.body: A control's visual state always reflects real, current data — never a momentary animation that plays regardless of outcome. If a control can't stay truthfully lit, it doesn't light up at all.

rules.name: The No Silent Write Rule
rules.body: Every action that writes to the server surfaces a toast naming what happened, with Undo when reversible. A tap that changes stored data and shows nothing is a defect.

dos: Do keep the dial-ring gauge, toggle switch, cart tray, and meal header as the signature vocabulary.
Do render every icon as inline SVG at a single stroke weight (~1.6–1.8px), matching the gauge ring's line quality.
Do reserve the amber glow for dial gauges only.
Do switch a dial's fill, glow, value, and percentage together on crossing target.
Do route every new food through the meal cart, never a direct write.
Do keep every functional label at ≥0.7rem (11.2px) and --text-dim at its current, contrast-corrected value.
donts: Don't use Unicode glyphs or emoji for icons.
Don't render a bezel as a flat gradient.
Don't widen the panel into a multi-column dashboard at desktop width.
Don't use monospace for free-text names.
Don't let a control fire a real write on a bare tap with no confirmation and no undo.
